svg.text: SIX MOVES

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: six monday changes. then the parts they kept back, which is why you can trust the rest.

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: 1 write the post someone would copy and send

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: ▸ copy-link is weighted 20.0. a follow is weighted 4.0. a like is 0.5. the weight on a copy-link share is 40x the

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: weight on a like. those weights multiply a predicted chance this viewer does the thing, and the file says the

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: sizes reflect how rare the action is, not an exchange rate in real hearts.

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: 2 write originals that a mutual would actually reply to

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: ▸ when someone who follows you back sees a post you wrote, the reply term on that view jumps from 5 to 20. that is

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: the biggest boost in the file, and it is the reply term only. it is not the whole post counting more. replies and

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: reposts get none of it.

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: param.rs:284-289 · ranking_scorer.rs:180-193

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: 3 if you want strangers, post an original

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: ▸ a reply never enters the stranger index. neither does a repost or a community post. even your own followers see a

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: reply or a repost at 0.75 of the usual weight.

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: 4 don't drop three posts into one scroll

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: ▸ your second post in the same person's refresh starts a third weaker (keeps 62.5%). your third keeps 43.75%. keep

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: stacking and it floors at 0.25. this is per request, per person, inside one refresh. three posts in a day, in

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: different scrolls, do not trigger it.

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: ranking_scorer.rs:614-616 · param.rs:222-239

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: 5 make it video. longer than 10 seconds

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: ▸ if it needs to live past tuesday: text drops out of retrieval in 24 to 48 hours. the 48 / 96 / 168 / 336 / 720h

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: video windows require duration strictly > 10,000 ms. evergreen video sits 5 years; those index writers check media

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: type only, not duration. VQV weight credit is a separate >10,000 ms gate.

svg.text: 6 treat one bad label like it can close every stranger door

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: ▸ 28 rules run on everybody. 26 more run on people who do not follow you. a labeled post can take a top-50 slot and

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: then vanish. an unsafe url writes four drop labels at once, and a verdict change relabels old posts. pin a bad or

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: low-quality url and the account gets SPAM_HIGH_RECALL for 7 days; that check re-runs on every follow you perform.

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: OneWeekInSecs is a botmaker DSL builtin not defined in the repo, so 7 days is implied by the constant name.

svg.text: WHAT THEY KEPT BACK

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: held back

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: they published the map. they kept the parts you'd use to game it.

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: ▸ no trained phoenix checkpoints ship. the published weights multiply a probability you cannot compute from the repo

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: ▸ the follower-count skip is 12.34, and the in-file comment says it out loud: production uses a different floor,

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: this is a mock to reduce gaming

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: ▸ every bot-detection operating point is 9.99, a sentinel that can never fire

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: ▸ the grok rubric prompts are withheld on purpose

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: ▸ twenty botmaker rules made the dump. not one uses a rate-limit, captcha, or suspend code. the velocity and

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: anti-automation rules are the ones missing

text.font-family: Menlo, Monaco, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: some numbers in the dump are fake on purpose. that's why you can trust the rest.
